title: Pokemon TCG Ancient Booster Energy Capsule Paradox Rift 159/182 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card is the perfect addition to any collector's set. The Ancient Booster Energy Capsule, from the Paradox Rift set, is a Pokémon Tool card that provides a unique energy boost to your Ancient creatures. With a beautiful holo finish, this card is sure to impress both avid collectors and casual fans alike. 

Featuring the card number 159/182 and manufactured by Nintendo, this card is an essential piece for any Pokémon TCG player. Don't miss your chance to add this rare card to your collection today!
